title: Expert planning proposal
description: Returned by each book-guided expert to the coordinator in planning mode. book_practices and standards_conformance are defined in shared-definitions.json.

role.description: Role id from ../agents/index.md; equals the assignment's role.

summary.description: Components, interfaces, data, and key flows in a few sentences.

change_cost.description: What it costs to evolve or reverse this option later.

smallest_viable_form.description: The smallest version of this option that meets known needs.

reason.description: Why it wins against the stated constraints.

assumptions.description: Missing facts or open decisions that could change the recommendation.
